:new: New project intention · #21 Formalization of p-adic modular forms

We are formalizing the theory of p-adic modular forms, starting with Serre's original approach and then moving on to more modern approach. One first concrete goal is the definition and study of the p-adic zeta function.

This is part of the ANR project FALSE.
